Privacy: only aggregate counts, never subscriber PII.

payload.title: Shared Studio Self-Host Server
payload.summary: Studio runs ONE shared Hetzner box (CX51: 16 vCPU AMD/32GB/160GB) as the default self-host target. Self-hosted PostgreSQL is the preferred DB tech (over cloud-managed). Treat the box as SHARED multi-tenant infra.
